ops.body:
Coordinator judgment on the root catalog review (reviews/catalog.json @ 82c383d), adopted as D16 in doc 64803ab.
F1/F2 are fixed through shared precise predicates:
- Complete = code state complete (not mixed/deferred) AND Completeness.Complete AND no omission.
- HeldReady = closure complete AND the referenced code root verified (no Mixed() bypass; a mixed checkpoint's older code root must verify).
- PickupReady = Complete ∧ HeldReady.
- ACK requires every unexpired carried checkpoint to be HeldReady.
- Retention tiers are computed over Complete checkpoints only. Newer mixed/incomplete checkpoints are kept in addition, bounded, and never evict a Complete one.
- The default list/pickup target is the newest PickupReady.
F3 (the plan forbids immortal pending):
- A checkpoint already expired at apply time (ExpiresAt = source activity + 7 d, never renewed) is DISPOSED: fenced, not recorded, never ready, never resurrected.
- A change whose unexpired checkpoints are all HeldReady is ACKed as processed, so the sender's pending clears.
- That ACK is never a per-checkpoint durability claim. Source-side status/list/picker shows "durable on peer P" only for Complete ∧ P.Acked ≥ its revision ∧ now < ExpiresAt. Mixed/incomplete checkpoints show as held-not-complete, and expired ones show nothing. Clock-skew honesty is documented.
Fix Run wf_19c51abb-f87: branch cc-sync/catalog-fixes from 82c383d, worktree /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/cc-sync/catalog-fixes, diff limited to catalog/consumer/assurance display. The three reproductions are written as failing tests first, then astra verification and a refix. It merges in phase 2b.
